abs_active.source: no ABS flag; lockups must be inferred from wheel speed

best_lap_ms.source: 0x78, SessionInfo.extra (GT7Eng: unstable in the raw packet)

car_id.source: 0x124 car code (corrupted for cars with 9+ gears)

current_lap_time_ms.source: C: 0x15C; A/B/~: derived from ticks since the line crossing

fuel_capacity_litres.source: 0x48 fuel capacity, unit conflicting (100 most cars, 5 karts, 0 EVs)

fuel_kg.source: GT7 reports volume or percent, not mass

fuel_litres.source: 0x44 fuel level, unit conflicting (litres per PDTools, % per GT7Eng): not emitted until a capture settles it; SessionInfo.extra['fuel_fraction'] = level / capacity

g_lat.source: B sway/heave/surge units unverified - not mapped

lap_distance_m.source: derived by integration; drifts ~1%; speed x tick time since the last line crossing

lap_number.source: 0x74 lap count (0 = not in a timed lap -> None)

max_rpm.source: 0x8A rev-limiter alert max RPM (approximates the limiter)

race_position.source: 0x84 when >= 1 (conflicting: pre-race grid position vs live position)

sector.source: GT7 has no sectors / split times

session_time_s.source: derived: packet-id ticks x 1/60 s while not paused

steering.source: B/~/C 0x128 wheel angle (rad) / nominal 450 deg half-lock; sign assumed left-positive, cross-checked against C road-wheel angles. Not in variant A

total_laps.source: 0x76 (0 for timed races / free runs -> None)

track_id.source: derived heuristic: start/finish position + heading + integrated lap length + total turning; layouts differing by < 1.5 % length and < 40 deg turning can still merge (unvalidated on real data)

track_length_m.source: derived by integration; drifts ~1%; this session's identifying lap(s), never longer than the registry's length

tyre_pressure_psi.source: not sent (0xD4..0xF3 is reserved, not pressures)

tyre_surface_temp_c.source: 0x60..0x6C surface temps, native FL, FR, RL, RR order

weather.source: GT7 sends time of day only

yaw_rad.source: 0x1C..0x28 rotation naming conflicting (quaternion vs angles) - not mapped

notes: Implemented from community protocol docs (Salsa20 written from the published spec; variants A/B/~/C). No lap distance or track id on the wire: distance is integrated from speed (~1% drift), the circuit is recognised from the start/finish line. Synthetic tests only - not yet tested on a real PS5. Enable on the Connect page.

fuel_kg.source: Dash.Fuel is a 0..1 tank fraction without capacity (fraction in SessionInfo.extra['fuel_fraction'])

g_lat.source: Sled.AccelerationX / 9.80665 (car-local, + = right; m/s^2 per community docs)

g_vert.source: Sled.AccelerationY / 9.80665 (whether gravity is included is undocumented)

gear.source: Dash.Gear: 1..10 forward; 0 / other values -> None (reverse/neutral encoding undocumented)

lap_completion.source: derived: LapNumber increment, time = Dash.LastLap (held up to 0.1 s for a stale LastLap, else untimed); valid=False only for a lap with a reset to track (trace un-anchored)

lap_distance_m.source: derived: Dash.DistanceTraveled minus its value at the observed line crossing (driven line, not a centreline); None until the first crossing of a session and after a reset to track

session_uid.source: derived: no session id on the wire (split on car/track/format change or race-clock reset)

speed_kph.source: Dash.Speed (m/s -> km/h); Sled format: derived |Velocity| (m/s -> km/h)

track_id.source: FM2023: Dash TrackOrdinal -> 'forza:<ordinal>'; FM7 / Horizon: derived start/finish fingerprint 'forza_fp:...' after the first full lap without a rewind or reset

track_length_m.source: derived: shortest recent driven lap (DistanceTraveled) within 2% of the median; median in SessionInfo.extra['track_length_nominal_m']

tyre_inner_temp_c.source: Forza sends a single temperature per tyre

tyre_surface_temp_c.source: Dash.TireTemp* (one value per tyre; degF per community docs -> degC; surface vs core undocumented)

tyre_wear_pct.source: FM2023 only: TireWear* (0..1 wear fraction per community -> %)

vel_x_mps.source: Sled.Velocity* is car-local, not world-frame: not mapped

brake.source: brake @60, 0..1; PS5 capture (PS4 build, 2026-10-11 live probe, replayed): full range, ABS active only with brake > 0.2

clutch.source: clutch @64, 0..1; PS5 rests at 1.0, so 1 = clutch engaged (pedal released) - direction not settled

current_lap_time_ms.source: lapTime @40 (ms; restarts at the line; PS5 capture (PS4 build, 2026-10-11 live probe, replayed))

g_lon.source: accG_frontal @36 (g); sign learned online against d(speed_Ms)/dt, None until unambiguous (PS5: +1, 4637 agreeing windows, 0 disagreeing)

g_vert.source: accG_vertical @28 (g; whether gravity is included is undocumented)

gear.source: gear @76: 0 = R, 1 = N, 2.. = 1st.. -> -1, 0, 1.. (MIT clients agree; PS5: 1 at standstill, 2..6 rising with speed; reverse not yet seen)

lap_completion.source: derived: lapCount increment with lapTime restarting (or restarting within 0.5 s), time = lastLap from the crossing packet, else a just-received RTLap, else held up to 0.5 s; one completion per lap; PS5 capture (PS4 build, 2026-10-11 live probe, replayed): ONE real crossing (lastLap = 138,817 ms in the crossing packet) plus a restored state that is correctly not a lap. Not yet run end to end in the service

lap_distance_m.source: derived: (carPositionNormalized @308 - line) x track length; line = spline 0 when the first increment coincides with the spline wrap (PS5: yes), else learned from two crossings; None until line and length are known; laps scaled by an unconfirmed length estimate are completed valid=False

lap_number.source: lapCount @52 + 1 (lapCount = completed laps; PS5 capture (PS4 build, 2026-10-11 live probe, replayed))

last_lap_time_ms.source: lastLap @44 (ms; 0 -> None; updated in the crossing packet on PS5)

pit_status.source: isInPit @24: 1 -> 2 (in the pit box), 0 -> None. PS5: byte 24 toggles while 26/27 stay 0 (natural alignment); 1 only with the car stationary in the pit box, 0 while driving the pit lane (~8 s, ~29 m off the racing line), so the pit lane is not detected

platform.source: not on the wire (PC and PS4 send identical structures); set by configuration

pos_x_m.source: carCoordinates[0] @316, metres (PS5 capture (PS4 build, 2026-10-11 live probe, replayed): path == integral of speed_Ms, 0.02 %)

rt_lap.source: RTLap 212 B UTF-16 (SUBSCRIBE_SPOT on a second socket; PS5 capture (PS4 build, 2026-10-11 live probe, replayed)): layout and strings decode -> GameEvent. Timing semantics UNVERIFIED: no RTLap was seen at a line crossing (only a reset marker and a re-send after a restored state); the service does not subscribe to SPOT. Used only when lastLap is stale

session_time_s.source: derived: host receive clock, not advanced while the simulation is frozen

session_uid.source: derived: no session id (split on handshake identity change / lapCount reset)

speed_kph.source: RTCarInfo.speed_Kmh @8 (abs); PS5 capture (PS4 build, 2026-10-11 live probe, replayed): == 3.6 x speed_Ms in every packet, 0..229 km/h

steering.source: steer @72 has no documented unit (PS5 raw -228..227; radians / wheel degrees / normalised all claimed): not mapped; raw range in SessionInfo.extra['steer_raw_range']

throttle.source: gas @56, 0..1; PS5 capture (PS4 build, 2026-10-11 live probe, replayed): full range, 1 with the car accelerating

track_id.source: handshake trackName/trackConfig -> 'ac:<track>[:<config>]' (PS5 sends trackConfig = trackName, so the layout is not on the wire)

track_length_m.source: derived: driven path (carCoordinates) / spline progress - an estimate after >= 15 % of a lap of clean driving from the first crossing (good to a few %: PS5 2945.3 m vs 2974.5 m over 1.76 laps), then fixed by the first full lap (the estimate kept if within 0.5 %); or known_tracks (kept if the first full lap is within 3 %). Layouts share a track id on consoles: only the length tells them apart. No full PS5 lap measured yet

track_name.source: handshake trackName (+ trackConfig); PS5: UTF-16 strings decode cleanly

traction_control.source: only an enabled flag (assists['tc']), no TC level

vel_x_mps.source: only speed magnitudes are sent, no velocity vector

notes: Implemented from Kunos' Remote Telemetry spec, the observed packet sizes (408 / 328 / 212 B) and two MIT clients; the same structures came back from a PS5 (2026-10-11 probe). Inputs, speed, gear, rpm, world position and lap times; no steering unit, tyres, fuel or sectors. Lap distance = spline position x a track length estimated after ~15-25 % of a lap and fixed by the first full lap (or a known track). Not yet tested against the PC game. Enable on the Connect page.
transport: UDP 9996 remote telemetry: pitwall handshakes with the game (nothing to set in AC)

notes: Protocol validated live on 2026-10-11 by the probe script (scripts/probe_ac.py, ks_audi_r8_plus at ks_silverstone): the handshake is answered (408 B UTF-16), RTCarInfo streams at 59.8 Hz (14,356 packets in 240 s, 0 rejected), isInPit sits at byte 24, RTLap (212 B) decodes on a second SPOT socket. pitwall's decoder and lap logic are validated on that recording (tests/recorded): one real lap crossing, timed 2:18.817 from lastLap in the crossing packet, and a restored state correctly not counted. Not yet run through pitwall's own client and service on the console: no AC lap has been stored, timed or coached end to end, and the service does not subscribe to RTLap. The console does not report the track layout, so layouts share a track id and are told apart by track length only.
The Xbox One version has no telemetry interface (several vendors agree).
Shared memory is local to the gaming PC: needs a reader there (Pitwall on that PC, or a relay to a Mac); not implemented. Broadcasting API lacks inputs.
No external telemetry on consoles. Only the separately labelled video-analysis option could apply.
SDK is local to the gaming PC: needs a reader there (Pitwall on that PC, or a relay); not implemented. Planned after GT7/Forza.
Research option only: HUD OCR (speed/gear) and minimap position; low precision, high latency.
